Horde Tatari skill stats

Roost’s three Horde skills and existing skill changes with a matching in-game stat label. Some changes to behavior and unlabeled values are not listed as numerical stats.

Regular

Chicken Came First

Throws stones to deal single-target damage. Sometimes throws an egg to the front-most ally in the same column, hatching a chick that deals small AoE damage and grants allies in range Egg: DEF Boost.

Lv 3

Cock-A-Doodle-Doo!

Periodically creates solar panels in front where enemies are concentrated, inflicting them with Solar: Slow and dealing continuous damage.

Min Trigger Interval

Lv 5

Get Roasted

Ignites. The smell of roast chicken will spread and grant this Tatari and allies Roast: DEF Boost. After becoming overcooked, removes the buff and recovers HP continuously until the skill can be used again.

Spread Interval
5s
Overcook Trigger Condition
HP Below 40%
DEF Boost
30%

Lv 7

Eggs Galore

Periodically throws giant eggs that turn enemies in range into screaming chickens and inflict Chicken: Fragile on them.

Last Stand5, 10, 15You and your teammate's Tatari gain a 30% DMG Boost, but the battle ends immediately if a Zobo reaches the bottom of the map.
Delayed Gains5, 10Obtain 400 energizers after 5 waves.
Never Too Late5Upgrade your lowest-level deployed Tatari to Lvl 8 after 12 waves.
